description: This file defines a SchemaOrg class for extracting and processing recipe data from schema.org structured data embedded in web pages. It includes methods for parsing various recipe attributes such as title, author, ingredients, instructions, ratings, and more, utilizing external utilities and handling different schema.org types.

classes.name: SchemaOrg
classes.description: A class for extracting recipe data from schema.org structured data embedded in web pages, supporting multiple schema types and providing methods to access recipe attributes.

methods.name: _contains_schematype
methods.description: Checks if a schema.org item contains a specific type.

methods.name: _find_entity
methods.description: Finds and returns a schema.org entity of a specific type within a given item.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SchemaOrg object by extracting and parsing structured data from page_data.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the website name from schema data.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Returns the language of the recipe.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Returns the recipe title.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Returns the recipe category.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Returns the author of the recipe.

methods.name: _read_duration_field
methods.description: Reads and converts a duration field to minutes.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Returns total cooking time in minutes.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Returns cooking time in minutes.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Returns preparation time in minutes.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Returns the recipe yield.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the recipe image URL.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of normalized ingredients.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of normalized nutrient information.

methods.name: _extract_howto_instructions_text
methods.description: Extracts instruction text from schema.org HowTo schema elements.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Returns the recipe rating.

methods.name: ratings_count
methods.description: Returns the number of ratings or reviews.

methods.name: cuisine
methods.description: Returns the cuisine type.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the recipe description.

methods.name: cooking_method
methods.description: Returns the cooking method.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Returns recipe keywords/tags.

methods.name: dietary_restrictions
methods.description: Returns dietary restrictions tags.
